releaseThreshold.basis: A material Washington GBIF source-family milestone completed 3705 exact county-species screens, moved 3003 unique final-matrix pairs, added 956 verified-present pairs, closed 95 protocol cells, removed three certification blockers, and retained eight complete immutable recovery partitions.

expectedVersusActual.qualification: Net movement, provider-call volume, and protocol closure matched semantic preflight exactly. Positive yield exceeded the historical maximum estimate by 63 pairs; that miss is retained rather than revised after the fact.

priorRoundAudit.processLesson: Attempt telemetry must be both captured before staging and copied into a durable MAIN-owned path before worker staging is retired; semantic preflight must also register real archive-response counts rather than placeholders.

recoveryAudit.qualification: Five initial GBIF occurrence responses returned HTTP 429. The 3510 completed pairs and 182 verified responses were preserved and replayed; only 195 affected pairs were retried. No failure, source silence, or incomplete page created absence, not-detection, not-applicability, or a complete claim.

planned.resourceFloor: Four 1600 MiB workers preserved 4904.711 MiB projected physical headroom and 10912.836 MiB projected commit headroom at preflight.

items: Changed the initial four-worker live topology after five HTTP 429 responses to four zero-network archive replays plus four sequential missing-request retries.
Promoted the verified Echium vulgare taxonomy identity into a provenance-bound recovery cache before the live retry, preventing a repeated taxonomy call.

Removed attempt telemetry accidentally copied inside eight immutable run directories because it was not declared by the closed run contract; preserved the same telemetry under MAIN-owned operations paths and rebuilt manifests.
Normalized generated recovery contract line endings after the whitespace gate rejected them before acquisition.
Reran two review receipts with millisecond-normalized UTC timestamps after seven-digit host formatting failed exact equality before queue mutation.
Reinvoked the disk-budget gate as a zero-worker postflight after the default dispatch contract correctly rejected zero workers.

The configured Vercel CLI token returned invalid, so exact runtime logs and private deployment metadata were not claimed; GitHub provider status plus immutable and canonical HTTP evidence established the bounded release identity.
The sandboxed npx launcher attempted to resolve the Playwright package from the registry, so the already-cached CLI was invoked directly without downloading or changing dependencies.
One malformed quoted Playwright expression created a 235-byte temporary error-output file; it was inspected and removed before the receipt-era gate.

One Playwright run-code wait expression returned SyntaxError after navigation while leaving the page loaded; direct page evaluation, screenshots, and clean consoles supplied the final mobile evidence.
The first consolidated final assertion harness collapsed six comma-separated PowerShell checks into one scalar; direct named assertions then passed all six checks.

requestTelemetry.qualification: The five HTTP 429 responses completed at the transport layer but failed source acquisition semantics. Recovery closed those exact requests; all 3705 final outcomes are complete and no-qualifying-evidence outcomes remain researched-unresolved.

attemptTelemetry.clockQualification: Elapsed duration, request counts, and peak-memory telemetry are measured locally. Source observations use provider-native retrievedAt timestamps; host wall time is not used to establish evidence freshness.

grossEventVolume.qualification: Gross attempt volume includes the four preserved partial executions and the eight recovery executions. It is reported separately from 3003 unique final-matrix movements and 3705 final integrated outcomes.

WA.overlapQualification: The final partitions completed 702 already-researched pairs; they remain valid explicit outcomes but are excluded from net movement. Fifty-four evidence-found outcomes overlapped prior verified-present pairs.

applicabilityAndDenominatorMovement.qualification: Round 54 was the evidence-screen follow-up to existing Washington applicability decisions. No denominator expansion is counted as county research movement.

certificationMovement.qualification: Washington now has all 163 applicable protocol cells complete and 150 current, but authoritative scope, full-catalog accounting, and baseline coverage still block certification.

expectedVersusActual.qualification: Net movement and protocol closure matched semantic preflight exactly. Five rate-limited occurrence calls raised live-provider cost above the initial contract; the recovery contract then matched actual calls exactly while reusing every verified response.

releaseOverhead.qualification: Known local generation, validation, build, push, provider-status deployment, production QA, and receipt-era integrity time is retained. Deployment duration uses provider-native GitHub Vercel status timestamps. Exact Vercel build and runtime-log timing are unavailable because the configured CLI token is invalid. The 396.207-second receipt-era suite passed on the complete external receipt object; the elapsed-duration field and this failed-wrapper disclosure were filled mechanically afterward.

localBrowserQa.localOnlyAnalyticsQualification: The local production server does not serve Vercel Analytics and produced the expected insights-script 404 and MIME errors. Production console and exact-deployment logs remain required.

externalVerification.qualification: GitHub main and Production deployment matched the exact content SHA; both the immutable Vercel host and canonical production alias passed six routes and six selected Washington file identities, for twelve live-to-local byte matches. Fresh desktop, mobile, and species-route behavior passed. Exact runtime-log rows were unavailable because the configured Vercel CLI token is invalid, so no zero-log claim is made. This later receipt evidence attests only to the already-observed content commit, not to the commit that records it or any future deployment. The complete receipt-era national research-integrity suite passed in 396.207 seconds; the elapsed-duration field and this failed-wrapper disclosure were filled mechanically afterward.

processLesson.lesson: When a national source wave is interrupted, preserve and replay every verified response, shrink live retry scope to only missing requests, and bind provider taxonomy identities to provenance before retry; HTTP failure remains an incomplete screen, never a negative determination.
applied: Preserved 3510 completed pairs and 182 verified response artifacts from four partial runs.
Retried only five missing occurrence requests affecting 195 pairs, sequentially, after the provider returned HTTP 429 under four-way live concurrency.
Reused 61 provenance-bound taxonomy identities and 182 archived responses, preventing 243 provider requests.
Captured all twelve attempt records before staging and promoted them to durable MAIN-owned operations paths.
Kept the four partial worker branches and worktrees because their response lineage is required by the recovery runs.

nextRankedSourcePortfolio.reason: Largest verified remaining net scope after Washington with lower structural retry risk than Montana. A fresh cache search and exact semantic preflight remain mandatory before provider access.
Second-largest verified remaining net scope, but three prior memory failures require smaller taxon chunks, per-taxon child processes, streaming parsing, or verified cache recovery before any retry.
Higher verified net movement than Rhode Island and no known structural failure history; it remains behind North Dakota and Montana on expected movement.

Certification remains at zero and full-catalog applicability/accounting dominates readiness. This should proceed concurrently with automated acquisition, but it requires authoritative source-specific review and cannot be forecast from GBIF throughput.

automatedNationalAcquisition.qualification: The rate includes initial partial and recovery worker time for this GBIF topology. It excludes preflight, MAIN review, integration, national generation, release, and future provider health; it is not an end-to-end completion date.

stateSpecificResearch.qualification: State authority, pagination, taxonomy, geography, and review burden require source-specific measurement; no blended rate is defensible.

applicabilityReview.qualification: Applicability is a separate evidence class and Round 54 measured no applicability-review rate.

blockedExceptions.qualification: These require exact source, taxonomy, geography, or job-shape resolution and cannot be extrapolated from successful acquisition.

freshnessWork.qualification: Round 54 closed Washington source-family cells but did not measure a general freshness-remediation rate.

releaseOverhead.qualification: Local overhead is measured for this release. Push, deployment, production QA, and receipt-era integrity remain unmeasured until external observation.
